Callout.Name: Diesel Spill
Callout.Message: Fuel spill across two lanes after a collision.
Callout.Advisory: No injuries, spill spreading, traffic still moving.

Script.Line: It is diesel and it is across two lanes.
The spill came off the truck and the truck has gone.
There is a van coming up that hill. Somebody is going to slide.

Lines.Approach: Diesel across two lanes and traffic driving through it. Somebody is going to slide.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
